summary: The earlier draft held TSupSet at 279.8108 instead of the expected 279.6732 at 75.0 min in staging_retrigger and at 70.0 min in off_grid_edges. The later draft set falseHoldDuration on `stageHold` to 0.0 s to release the stage without delay and passed every scenario.

changes.title: Remove false hold on staging
changes.text: Changed `stageHold` falseHoldDuration to 0.0 s so the false condition clears at once. This lets TSupSet fall to the expected 279.6732 at 75.0 min in staging_retrigger and at 70.0 min in off_grid_edges instead of remaining at 279.8108.
